verdict.rationale: Nitrokey sells an NFC-enabled model (Nitrokey 3A NFC) and documents FIDO2/U2F/OTP login flows and an Android/NitroPhone integration, implying NFC tap-to-auth is technically supported, but no evidence explicitly confirms tapping the key against a phone to authenticate in mobile browsers/apps, nor any hands-on report of this working. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or user testimony of NFC-based authentication on phones, coverage across major mobile browsers/apps, and confirmation it works as smoothly as competitors.
